description: List distinct provider-native tag/label keys actually present in this account's cost data (AWS Cost Allocation Tags, GCP/Hetzner labels, Azure tags) — useful for discovering what a "tags.<key>" cost-tag-rule match could reference before creating one. Only ever populated on grain='service' rows. Omit cost_source_id to search across every enabled provider.
name: list_cost_source_tag_keys
